items.html: Now, in the Rosh of AA, in which there was a selection from the Melachim who had some blemish in them, therefore his Bina, being more of judgments than Hochma, as is known — for judgments always arouse from Bina, since she is a female — could not receive the light of Atik that clothes within the Rosh of AA in the high place in the Rosh, where the light is abundant and close to Atik. Therefore she descended below, to the phase of the throat of AA, and being there farther away, she had the capacity to receive the light of Atik.
